problem_statement: Build a brand-new public Changelog page at the /changelog route of the Remix Admin Template (Remix v2 on Vite). The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the catch-all Page Not Found. Construct the whole page from scratch, matching the site's existing design system: the same centered Logo nav and Netlify footer used on the public home page, the cyan-accented header card, Inter type scale, and slate text. The page lists the product's recent releases newest-first: an intro header, a 'Recent releases' section, and one card per release showing its version, a release tag, the date, a one-line summary, and a list of Added/Improved/Fixed changes. No authentication and no Supabase data — this is a static marketing-style page.
required_content: A page header titled 'Changelog' with a one-line intro describing that it lists every release newest-first
At least four release cards, each headed by an <h3> version heading in the form 'Version X.Y.Z' (the newest, listed first, is 'Version 2.4.0'); the older cards use earlier version numbers
Each release card shows a release tag (Latest/Patch/Feature) and a date
Each release card has a one-line summary and a list of labelled changes (Added / Improved / Fixed)
The shared centered Logo nav at the top and the Netlify copyright footer at the bottom, reused from the site's public pages
design_constraints: Reuse the existing Logo component and the public-page layout (centered nav, grow main, footer)
Reuse the cyan accent palette (border-cyan-500 / bg-cyan-100/20 header card, bg-cyan-500 tag), slate text colors, and Inter font already in the design system
White rounded shadow-sm cards on the slate-100 body background, consistent with the home Guide cards
Public route: no Supabase loader / no auth redirect (renders offline like the home page)

Palette tokens to reuse from the design system: cyan accent 'cyan-500' (#06b6d4) for the header-card border and release tag background, 'cyan-100' at 20% opacity for the header-card fill, slate text ('slate-900' headings, 'slate-700' body), white cards on a 'slate-100' body background, and the Inter / system-ui sans-serif type scale
author_notes: Scheme A: baseline has an empty app/routes/changelog.tsx (returns null → blank page, route exists but no content, so it does NOT hit the catch-all 404 chrome). reference implements the full changelog page. bad renders the header shell only and omits the entire 'Recent releases' section + release cards → fails the dom_assertions (h2 Recent releases + h3 version headings). Three workspace source trees md5-distinct. Public route (no Supabase) so it serves offline via npm run dev.
